title: Printer prints blank pages
symptom: Pages come out of the printer completely blank
user_description: I printed a letter and a blank page came out. The printer sounded like it was working normally.

options.text: Keep sending the job until it prints
options.why: Wastes paper and toner. Repeating the same job rarely changes the result.
Expensive and premature. Blank pages usually have simple causes.

options.text: Print the printer's own test page to separate a printer fault from a document or driver problem, and check the cartridge is installed correctly with no protective seal left on
options.why: If the test page is also blank, the printer or its supplies are at fault, such as a missing toner or a seal left on a new cartridge. If it prints, the document or driver is the cause.
Never the first step. It is destructive and unlikely to be the cause.

hints: How can you tell whether the problem is the document or the printer?
What could stop toner or ink reaching the paper?
Could something have been left on a new cartridge?
real_world_tip: Brand new cartridges often have a plastic seal or tape that must be removed. Forgetting it gives blank pages.
